author: K. L. Pryor
title: All Spring Grove 3rd-graders participated in 2024-25 MCA math test
text:
According to the Minnesota Department of Education , third-grade students at Spring Grove Elementary School achieved the highest participation rate on the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA.
Among the 113 students who took this section of the test at Spring Grove Elementary, 25 were from the third grade.
Based on test standards, 56% of third-graders were determined to be proficient in mathematics.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are Minnesota’s state tests designed to measure student progress toward academic standards and comply with federal and state requirements. The assessments include math, reading, and science, varying by grade level. Most students take the MCA, while eligible special education students may participate in the Alt MCA instead.
Data from Minnesota’s Report Card highlights that MCA proficiency has decreased compared with pre-pandemic figures . Math proficiency has dropped by more than 7% from 2019, while reading proficiency is nearly 5% lower.
Mathematics MCA at Spring Grove Elementary School (2024-25): Participation and Proficiency by Grade Grade # of Students Tested Proficiency in mathematics 3rd 25 56% 4th 27 67% 5th 35 77% 6th 26 62% *Data for small student groups is suppressed by some schools to ensure privacy. Information in this article was obtained from the Minnesota Department of Education. The source data can be found here .
